Hotel prices / Canada, Latin America, Caribbean

Hotel prices in Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean: 687 hotels across booking sites

43 cities and 687 hotels. For each hotel: the price on each booking site we recorded for the same stay, low to high, the going rate, and which site was lowest against it. Prices are per night, from snapshots taken September 28, 2026 to October 10, 2026; each city page names its own snapshot and stay. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

At 567 of the 687 hotels, a site was 5% or more below the going rate on its page (all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees); the sites lowest there most often: Super.com (223 hotels), the hotel's own site (40 hotels), Vio.com (38 hotels), Traveluro (36 hotels). A tie counts for each site.
